description: Cliffside (100x50): a wide level-4 plain west of the start between sea cliffs and highland terraces; both Deep Ore Veins with Deep Mine sites, a Deep Drill, the Launch Pad and the sandstone quarry lie on that plain, the Deep Processor on the level-14 highland, the second Deep Ore Source with its drill on the north-east level-2 terrace, and five Human Record Caches around two Archive Excavations; no reactor fits beside the mines and the pad.
